legFlavors: Dawn breaks over a Waffle House sign. Coffee smells like salvation.
A van with too many stickers passes you doing exactly the speed limit.
The radio finds a staticy live archive tape for thirty seconds.
Road construction narrows everything to one nervous lane.
You count seventeen tour stickers on a guardrail.
Heat shimmer on asphalt. A billboard promises a grocery store two exits back.
Rain on the windshield. Wipers on the one setting that never quite works.

truck_stop.label: Truck stop
truck_stop.copy: Neon beer signs and questionable breakfast burritos. Lot kids trade stickers by the diesel pumps.

rest_area.label: Rest area
rest_area.copy: Picnic tables, vending machines, and the eternal smell of sunscreen on asphalt.

farmers_market.label: Roadside farmers market
farmers_market.copy: Local honey, kettle corn, and a guy selling tie-dye out of a Subaru.

supermarket.label: Supermarket
supermarket.copy: Fluorescent aisles and sale stickers. Stock up on food and beer before the lot markup hits.
